description: table.place pack (.tbpp.json) — see docs/packs.md and llms.txt

scope.description:
'table' = the shared game, loaded once per lobby by the host (TTS analog: the mod/save).
'player' = what one player brings, spawned per seat (TTS analog: a Saved Object, e.g. a deck-builder export).
scope.title: scope

slot.description: Stable id within the pack, e.g. 'main', 'discard'
slot.title: slot

back.description: Face ref for the card back
back.title: back

items.description:
A pack is a named, serializable definition of a game's contents —
decoupled from live game state. Packs are templates; the gameStore
holds the instance. See SPEC.md §4d.

code.description: Stable code within the pack, e.g. 'AS' (ace of spades)
code.title: code

face.description: Face ref: https url, `sheet:` descriptor, or `gen:` scheme
face.title: face

pieces.description: tokens/pawns/counters that spawn with the pack

color.description: hex tint; pawns/counters without images render in this color
color.title: color

imageUrl.description: token top-face image ref (resolved like card faces)
imageUrl.title: imageUrl

radius.description: world radius of the piece footprint
radius.title: radius

position.description: table-plane position [x, z] in world units
position.title: position

pieces.title: pieces

overlays.description: board/map images laid on the table
overlays.title: overlays

source.description: provenance: set by converters (e.g. the TTS importer), absent on native packs
source.title: source

$schema.description: optional editor-validation hint; always written on export
$schema.title: $schema

specVersion.description:
Semver of the pack spec this document was authored against. Always
written on export; optional on read so files predating spec versioning
still validate and still import.
specVersion.title: specVersion
